## Loading:
```{r}
dataset <- open_dataset("C161_output_v10_26_1/")

# target_market <- "another-us-debt-downgrade-before-2027"

df_plot <- dataset |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(trade_date = as_date(trade_date)) |>
  filter(!is.na(trade_date)) |>
  group_by(trade_date) |>
  summarise(
    daily_volume        = sum(daily_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_traders      = sum(unique_traders, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_wallet_volume   = max(max_wallet_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    volume_7d_ma        = mean(volume_7d_ma, na.rm = TRUE),
    volume_velocity     = mean(volume_velocity, na.rm = TRUE),
    hedger_volume_ratio = sum(hedger_volume_ratio * daily_volume, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(daily_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(trade_date)

dataset |> 
  distinct(market) |> 
  collect()

head(df_plot$trade_date, 10)

nrow(df_plot)

# 
# df_plot <- df_plot |>
#   mutate(
#     # Use rollsum instead of rollmean to get the 7-day cumulative total
#     volume_7d_sum = zoo::rollsum(daily_volume, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right")
#   )
#

# summary(df_plot$daily_volume)
# summary(df_plot$volume_7d_ma)
# summary(df_plot$volume_7d_sum)
```

## 1:
```{r 1a} 
df_long <- df_plot |>
  dplyr::select(trade_date, daily_volume, volume_7d_ma) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(daily_volume, volume_7d_ma), 
    names_to = "metric", 
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(metric = case_match(metric,
    "daily_volume" ~ "Daily Volume",
    "volume_7d_ma" ~ "7-Day Moving Average"
  ))


ggplot(df_long, aes(x = trade_date, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("#2b5c8f", "#e84545")) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Trading Volume & Trend",
    y = "USD Volume",
    x = " ",
    color = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85)
        )



df_ma_only <- df_plot |>
  filter(!is.na(volume_7d_ma))

ggplot(df_ma_only, aes(x = trade_date, y = volume_7d_ma)) +
  geom_area(fill = "red", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Platform 7-Day Moving Average Trading Volume",
    y = "USD",
    x = " "
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  )


```
```{r}

df_plot2 <- dataset |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(trade_date = as_date(trade_date)) |>
  filter(!is.na(trade_date)) |>
  group_by(trade_date) |>
  summarise(
    daily_volume = sum(daily_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(trade_date) |>
  mutate(
    volume_7d_ma = zoo::rollmean(daily_volume, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )

df_long <- df_plot2 |>
  filter(!is.na(volume_7d_ma)) |>
  dplyr::select(trade_date, daily_volume, volume_7d_ma) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(daily_volume, volume_7d_ma), 
    names_to = "metric", 
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(metric = case_match(metric,
    "daily_volume" ~ "Daily Volume",
    "volume_7d_ma" ~ "7-Day Moving Average"
  ))


p11 <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = trade_date, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = metric),
            linewidth = 1) +
scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()))+  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Trading Volume & Trend",
    y = "USD Volume",
    x = NULL,
    color = "Metric",
    linetype = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.80, 0.85)
  )

p11
```



```{r}
top_n_markets <- 15
max_title_length <- 35  

df_top_markets <- dataset |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(market) |>
  summarise(
    total_volume = sum(daily_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(order_by = total_volume, n = top_n_markets) |>
  mutate(
    short_market = str_trunc(market, width = max_title_length, side = "right"),
    short_market = fct_reorder(short_market, total_volume)
  )

p_top_markets <- ggplot(df_top_markets, aes(x = total_volume, y = short_market)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2b5c8f", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::label_dollar(accuracy = 0.1, scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())(total_volume)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20)) 
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Top ", top_n_markets, " Markets by Cumulative Volume"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )

print(p_top_markets)
```

```{r}
df_all_markets <- dataset |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(market) |>
  summarise(
    total_volume = sum(daily_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(total_volume > 0)

p_distribution <- ggplot(df_all_markets, aes(x = total_volume)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(fill = after_stat(x)), 
    color = "white", 
    bins = 40, 
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", guide = "none") + 
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Volume Distribution Across Selected Markets",
    x = "Total Market Volume (USD, Log Scale)",
    y = "Num of Markets"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_distribution)


```

## 2:
```{r 2} 
df_long_part <- df_plot |>
  dplyr::select(trade_date, unique_traders, volume_velocity) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(unique_traders, volume_velocity), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric = case_match(metric, "unique_traders" ~ "Unique Traders", "volume_velocity" ~ "Volume Velocity"))

p2 <- ggplot(df_long_part, aes(x = trade_date, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("lightgreen", "red")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Platform Participation & Velocity",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none")

print(p2)
```
Lines align very well.

## 4:
```{r 4}
p4 <- ggplot(
  df_plot |> filter(!is.na(hedger_volume_ratio)), 
  aes(x = trade_date, y = hedger_volume_ratio / 100) # Divide by 100 to convert to true ratio
) +
  geom_line(color = "#4e8098", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#1f4068", size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Hedger Volume Proportion",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hedger Volume Share"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p4)
```

## 5:
```{r 5}
df_intensity <- df_plot |>
  mutate(avg_volume_per_trader = daily_volume / unique_traders)

p5 <- ggplot(df_intensity, aes(x = trade_date, y = avg_volume_per_trader)) +

print(p5)

#  whether whales take a larger share during quiet or active days
p6 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = daily_volume, y = max_wallet_volume)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "green", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "orange", linewidth = 1, se = TRUE) +

print(p6)


p7 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = trade_date, y = volume_velocity)) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

    title = "Platform Volume Velocity Momentum",

    y = "Volume Velocity Index"

print(p7)


p8 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = hedger_volume_ratio, y = daily_volume)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "blue", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Hedging Activity Proportion by Market Scale",
    subtitle = "Evaluating if large volume days attract higher hedging ratios",
    x = "Hedger Volume Ratio",
    y = "Daily Volume"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p8)
```

```{r}
df_full <- dataset |> collect()

print(dim(df_full))
```

```{r}

df_full <- read_parquet("C161_output_v10_26_1/daily_feature.parquet") |>
  mutate(trade_date = as_date(trade_date))

df_wallet_daily <- read_parquet("C161_output_v10_26_1/wallet_daily.parquet") |>
  mutate(trade_date = as_date(trade_date))

colnames(df_wallet_daily)

print(dim(df_full)) 

ggplot(df_full, aes(x = trade_date, y = daily_volume, group = market)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1, color = "blue") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Full Daily Volume",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily Volume (Log Scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



df_quantiles <- df_full |>
  group_by(trade_date) |>
  summarise(
    p25 = quantile(unique_traders, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(unique_traders, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75 = quantile(unique_traders, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


  # Interquartile Range 25th–75th percentiles

ggplot(df_quantiles, aes(x = trade_date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median), color = "midnightblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Unique Trader Dispersion Across Markets",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Unique Traders per Market"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



ggplot(df_full |> filter(daily_volume > 0), aes(x = max_wallet_volume / daily_volume)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Single-Wallet Volume Concentration Distribution",
    x = "Max Wallet Share of Daily Volume",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}


df_full |>
  mutate(
    volume_tier = case_when(
      daily_volume < 100 ~ "Micro (< $100)",
      daily_volume >= 100 & daily_volume <= 10000 ~ "Mid ($100 - $10k)",
      daily_volume > 10000 ~ "High (> $10k)"
    ),
    # Explicitly set the factor levels in your preferred order
    volume_tier = factor(volume_tier, levels = c("Micro (< $100)", "Mid ($100 - $10k)", "High (> $10k)")),
    max_share = max_wallet_volume / daily_volume
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(max_share)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = max_share)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "midnightblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  facet_wrap(~ volume_tier, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Wallet Concentration by Volume Tier",
    x = "Max Wallet Share of Daily Volume",
    y = "Frequency (Days)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  )


```


```{r}
df_full |>
  arrange(market, trade_date) |>
  group_by(market) |>
  mutate(
    lag_velocity = lag(volume_velocity, 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(volume_velocity) & !is.na(lag_velocity)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lag_velocity, y = volume_velocity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2, color = "green") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Volume Velocity Persistence",
    x = "Previous Day's Volume Velocity",
    y = "Current Day's Volume Velocity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = .5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


```


```{r}
df_whale_concentration <- df_wallet_daily |>
  group_by(trade_date, wallet) |>
  summarise(wallet_daily_vol = sum(wallet_vol, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(
    rank = min_rank(desc(wallet_daily_vol)),
    total_traders = n(),
    is_top_5pct = rank <= pmax(1, ceiling(total_traders * 0.05))
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total_daily_vol = sum(wallet_daily_vol, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_5pct_vol = sum(wallet_daily_vol[is_top_5pct], na.rm = TRUE),
    whale_share = top_5pct_vol / total_daily_vol,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


p_whales <- ggplot(df_whale_concentration, aes(x = trade_date, y = whale_share)) +
  geom_area(fill = "purple", alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.25, se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), 
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 5% Wallet Volume Share Over Time",
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Whale Volume Share"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "#2b2b2b", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#666666", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "#444444", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#555555", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#eaeaea", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)
  )

print(p_whales)
```
